review_description: Had this installer to do a number of solar jobs for me over the years and I've never found I needed to call anyone else. A top notch bloke who really knows what he's about - and reasonably priced. You get what you pay in this world and there are far too many installers out there only to make a quick buck - not this fellow. His after sales service is great - hasn't ever left me hanging, although because of his talent I'd say he's in great demand, hence you might have to wait a little longer than any other installer to get him out. Hope he lives forever.
